user_input: How many paid leave days do full-time employees get per year?
retrieved_contexts:
Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid annual leave per year.
Unused leave days roll over to the next year up to a maximum of 5 days.
Leave requests must be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance through the HR portal.
Sick leave is tracked separately and does not count against annual leave.

All business expenses must be submitted within 30 days of the transaction date via the Expensify portal.
Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to $75 per day; itemized receipts are required for any expense over $25.
Airfare must be booked through the corporate travel portal; economy class is standard for flights under 6 hours.
Reimbursements are processed within 10 business days of manager approval.
response: Full‑time employees accrue **20 days of paid annual leave per year** [1].
reference: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid annual leave per year.
